message.content:
**Battle of Waterloo – Casualty figures**

| Side | Approximate casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|---------------------------------------------------|
| **Allied (British, Dutch‑German, Prussian)** | ~22 000 |
| **French** | ~12 000 |
| **Total** | ~34 000 (≈ 25 000–30 000 depending on source) |

> *Sources:*  
> • Britannica: “About 25 000 casualties.”  
> • Wikipedia (Battle of Waterloo): “Allied casualties: 22 000; French casualties: 12 000.”  
> • Historical analyses often quote a range of 25 000–30 000 total casualties.

> **Note:** Exact numbers vary because contemporary reports were incomplete and later historians have used different criteria for counting wounded, missing, and dead. The commonly cited figure of roughly 25 000 is a rounded estimate that captures the overall scale of the loss.
